_comment: Training line items offered in the RFQ pricing table.
Add an entry here to offer a new training type - no code change needed.
'numbered': true appends #1, #2, #3 ... in the order the trainings are added,
which is how ADV_TRAIN#1 and ADV_TRAIN#2 appear in a quote.
'description' is printed verbatim to the customer, so word it the way you
want it read. Prices are never set here - they are filled in Word.
